CL_max.note: unsourced; Park & Choi 2010 report max CL at alpha 30-35 deg but the value was not read

rho.note: ISA sea-level air density; the solver itself never defaults rho

level_lift_proxy.correspondence: level-flight proxy: lift 0.5*rho*V^2*S*CL >= m*g (gamma = 0). A glide at path angle gamma needs only L = W*cos(gamma); this constraint is NOT a statement that flight or gliding is feasible

CL.source: caller-set (maximum usable) lift coefficient; NOT supplied by any source in this repo

g.source: standard acceleration of gravity, defined value 9.80665 m/s^2 (CGPM 1901)

rho.source: caller-set air density; NOT supplied by any source in this repo
